execution_isolation: Each case starts a separate subprocess. When running notebook cells, that subprocess creates a fresh in-process kernel. No browser file-URL or socket-policy workaround.

recording.candidate_actual: candidate-results.json initially pending; later append/new run file tied to final SHA
recording.failures: preserve raw stdout/stderr, return code, expectation, actual, and classification; never overwrite an invalid run as though it had not occurred

lanes.purpose: Use the actual lesson aggregation/conversion functions on independent grid/scalar/category inputs; report extracted cell/function provenance and any minimal adapter. No reviewer rewrite is evidence that candidate logic works.

Reviewer solves independent-transfer-spec.json using independent code and at least two valid models. This demonstrates oracle consistency and assessment flexibility only; not candidate automatic validation or student performance.
Execute all actual candidate cells in order from fresh kernel; compare stored outputs and actual values; preserve blank student response cells.
Follow the candidate actual A-E/bridge setup instructions in separate fresh subprocesses; execute provided prep/example cells only; blank answers remain unobserved.
Check formulas/units, input/axis semantics, official-source scope, plan prerequisites, total required exercise mapping/burden, score-vs-trained-model language.

cases.input: asymmetric 2x2 grid [[1,0],[1,0]], then a second grid with same shape
cases.expected: sum correct named axis; first column 2, not first row 1; compare all output values, not just shape

cases.input: batch containing two different observations; reverse observation order only, then transpose each grid
cases.expected: respect sample axis and each named spatial/channel axis; ordering effect is explicit

cases.input: numeric 0, None, CSV blank/NaN, empty/all-missing per published domain
cases.expected: 0 retained; missing and unknown-label policies separated; no unsupported domain claim

cases.input: unknown-target S0 extreme100; validation reading999; label permutation on validation only
cases.expected: train-only fit state excludes S0 under this independent reduced contract and never fits validation; fit state invariant to validation changes

cases.input: unseen green category plus bijective category renaming
cases.expected: candidate declared unknown-category policy and nominal meaning; do not assume category code is a physical distance

cases.input: ID-only shuffle and joint row+label+ID shuffle; missing/duplicate IDs
cases.expected: reject invalid alignment or preserve per-ID correspondence; reject null IDs where contract requires

cases.input: same independent training/validation X; centroid vs3NN
cases.expected: both fit and valid output accepted despite different V9 prediction; no forced exact answer across model choices

cases.input: feature matrix with columns swapped but same shape, late target-derived field injected
cases.expected: semantic mismatch/leakage detected or described; valid tensor shape alone is insufficient

cases.input: CSV row order/header/name/shape mutations; physical write replaced by memory
cases.expected: actual lesson file event/reopen required if lesson claims physical file; reviewer oracle file events excluded

cases.input: final candidate source and all cells
cases.expected: run all supplied code, preserve empty assessment, compare outputs/PNG presence; distinguish successful run from learning outcomes

cases.input: final candidate exact original A-E and bridge pointers/setup
cases.expected: fresh provided-code route resolves dependencies and schemas; no student empty cell counted as solved

cases.input: candidate vs frozen criterion and plan
cases.expected: existing required goals mapped, one coherent deepening path, no unsubstantiated mastery/time claim or wholesale advanced first-week requirement

limits: If candidate function has a deliberately different published domain, record applicability and adapt semantic test without changing the frozen new contract/results.
Unsupported feature conversion in a lesson is a scope finding, not permission to relabel a reviewer implementation as candidate behavior.
A new model may predict differently; assess validity, not answer matching.
No claim of a real student or secure hidden test is made.
